Rachid Behna, merchant.
Alexandria: Rue de l'Eglise Maronite No. 1. Telephone No. 22578, 44.460. Telegraphic address: BEHNA ALEXANDRIE.
Cairo: Rue Neuve No. 49. Telephone No. 50-723. P.O. Box 120. Telegraphic address: ANHEB LE CAIRE.
Alexandria, 13 June 1936.

Friday, 12 June 1936.
Sir, after greetings, we inform you that we have received on your account [unclear]. For [unclear] we have disbursed [unclear] and this serves as acknowledgment of receipt. A check for the amount of [unclear] has been presented. Please send your esteemed reply.
List of names and amounts (in Egyptian pounds): Iskandar [unclear] — 958.0; Muhammad Abd Al-Hamid — 2000; Muhammad Al‑Mutawalli — 646.5; Muhammad Al‑Siyoufi and Awad Anwar — 250; [other names unclear]. Total — 12,875 [unclear]. With highest respect.
